$comment: Unified intake specification for 1inch (Network Aggregator v6), Paraswap (Augustus), and KyberSwap (Elastic/Aggregation API). Three venues share one Eswap registration shape: Eswap is not a native pool for any of them, so each is registered as a CUSTOM VENUE that must be constructed into a route. Selectors are keccak256 over the exact signatures in src/v4/.

settlementPool.role: THE liquidity venue: the deep ETH/USDC pool the physical fill executes on.

poolKeys.staleHooksWarning: A wrong `hooks` value addresses the predecessor pool 0x9aa5ebac305d4fd646bca230471bcb0df55d89b8b32e94559a0a7471b21ccaae instead of the live pool.

inputs.name: recipient
inputs.note: position owner; receives the ERC-6909 claim

exactInputSingleWithLeverageAggregator.purpose: Executes a caller-supplied venue leg inside the SAME v4 unlock. This is the hook each aggregator below uses to compose Eswap with its own prefill.

quoteExactInputSingleWithLeverage.signedInputWarning: VERIFIED LIVE: amountIn is a signed int256 but its sign is DISCARDED — EswapRouter.quoteExactInput takes absAmount = amountSpecified < 0 ? -amountSpecified : amountSpecified, so negative and positive inputs of equal magnitude return the identical amountOut. This is therefore ALWAYS an exact-input quote and amountOut is always POSITIVE. Do not branch on the amountOut sign.

registerPool.access: onlyOwner — integrators CANNOT self-register. Only ETH/USDC (fee 3000) is live.

LeveragedSwapRouted.verificationStatus: topic0 locally derived and matching the compiled artifact; contracts NOT yet Sourcify verified. Re-confirm against the verified ABI.

gas.overheadAbovePlainSwap: ~950k-1M, NOT the ~110k some intake templates request
gas.caveat: fork-local base fee; re-measure with live estimateGas

costModelBps.routingRule: Only route when your edge exceeds 30 bps plus margin.

riskParameters.minMargin: CollateralTooLow() = 0xb67e07e5 observed at 0.01 USDC margin; read the live minimum
riskParameters.slippage: quote-derived floor; a raw exact-output floor is structurally negative against the 100 bps router discount

solverRequirement.mechanism: adapter.defaultSolver, falling back to backupSolver; unregistered -> revert SolverNotRegistered

doNotClaim: solver capital is 'guaranteed by the smart contract' — uncovered shortfall is recorded as badDebt, and solver payout is truncated to proceeds
an automated keeper protects live positions — EswapLiquidationKeeper IS deployed (0x5E8aDA65050962c62A815932BF38dc144E0545DA, verified live) but watchesLength() == 0, so it currently protects nothing
any APY figure without measured on-chain yield history

130.note: 1inch supports Unichain (chain 130). Regional routing endpoints apply; use the chain-130 API base, not the Ethereum one.

1inchNetworkAggregatorV6.whyNotNative: 1inch discovers liquidity from its own pool registries and on-chain pool contracts. Eswap's leveraged surface is reached through a call into EswapLeverageAdapter, not a pool 1inch can enumerate, so it must be modelled as a custom venue with explicit calldata.
1inchNetworkAggregatorV6.calldataTemplate: 0xb4d2ebae ++ abi.encode(address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint24 fee, uint8 leverage, uint256 amountIn, uint256 minAmountOut, address recipient)
1inchNetworkAggregatorV6.encoding: solidityPack-style manual encoding; argument order is positional and NOT named
1inchNetworkAggregatorV6.approvalWarning: Approve MARGIN only. The borrowed leg is pulled from the SOLVER by the router (Router:784) and settled with settleFor(hook). Approving notional from the trader is wrong and unsafe.

composition.method: Use exactInputSingleWithLeverageAggregator (0x062c4889) to run the 1inch prefill and the leveraged leg inside one v4 unlock.

route.callData: 1inch swap calldata returning into Eswap's expected tokenOut

quoter.signedInputWarning: signed int256 input, but the sign is discarded upstream — always an exact-input quote, amountOut is always positive

intake.form: https://portal.1inch.io/ — submit as a custom/integration venue
fieldsNeeded: supported pairs (ETH/USDC fee 3000 registered; WETH/USDC NOT registered)
measured gas and the explicit correction that 110k is wrong

130.note: Paraswap lists Unichain. API-side token/dex registry entries required.

paraswapAugustus.whyCustom: Augustus classifies liquidity by pool type. A leveraged open has no symmetric spot reserve to read, so a custom type with an explicit calldata producer is required rather than a reserves-backed pool entry.
paraswapAugustus.deltaBalanceNote: Augustus deltaBalance resolves a route by its net token delta. A leveraged open DELTA-IN is (margin + borrow) of tokenIn and DELTA-OUT is the bought amount, but the CALLED contract only receives `amountIn` = margin. Declare the net delta from the ROUTE, not from the calldata, or Augustus will compute a wrong input requirement.
paraswapAugustus.calldataProducer: Returns ABI-encoded exactInputSingleWithLeverage(...) args for (tokenIn, tokenOut, fee, leverage, amountIn, minAmountOut, recipient).
paraswapAugustus.destTokenNote: ETH is currency0 == address(0) in the accounting pool, so the 0x-address is the correct token identity in Eswap calldata even though WETH is the ERC-20 wrapper.

130.note: KyberSwap Elastic deployment status on Unichain must be confirmed with Kyber before submitting a route; do not assume parity with Ethereum/Base.

kyberSwap.whyCustom: KyberSwap's Aggregation API reads pool reserves from a pool contract. Eswap exposes no reserve getters — its balance sheet is transient v4 deltas — so metadata must be supplied out of band.

tokenAddressMapping.note: Map Eswap's native-ETH identity to the Kyber token id Kyber expects for native/wrapped.

metadataRequired: supported pairs with explicit registration status

crossVenueNotes.amountSemantics: amountIn is MARGIN everywhere. notional = margin * leverage. borrowed = margin * (leverage - 1), supplied by the solver.
crossVenueNotes.approvalDiscipline: Approve margin to the adapter. Never approve the borrow from the trader; the router pulls it from the solver via safeTransferFrom(params.solver, manager, borrowAmount) (Router:784) then settleFor(hook).
crossVenueNotes.closePath: Positions are ERC-6909 claims owned by `recipient`. Close with EswapRouter.closePosition as the direct caller — the router's C-1 rule requires the trader to call directly, so a router-based aggregator cannot close on the user's behalf without the user's signature.
crossVenueNotes.v4LockHazard: A flash source that holds the PoolManager lock (Balancer-style, or v4 unlock/flash accounting) will make the router's own unlock revert AlreadyUnlocked (0x5090d6c6). InventoryFlashProvider is external and never takes the lock, which is why it composes.
